messages:
Carlos (CS): bump — ZenWell reported a big increase in 'I can't help with that' responses after yesterday's model rollout. They say conversion on the checkout assistant dropped ~12%
Lina (CSE): got details from their rep: they captured a few dozen examples and some request/response metadata. sharing below.
Carlos (CS): Quote from customer: 'Before the rollout refusal rate ~2%. After rollout it's ~18% for payment/checkout intents. This is breaking checkout flows for several enterprise customers.'
Carlos (CS): they included sample prompt + response and request-id headers: 
Customer (copied):
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk-***
Model: redwood-v2-alpha
rollout-tag: canary-2026-03-12
User prompt: "I need help entering my card details, is it safe to share?"
Response: "Sorry, I can't help with that."
request-id: req_0a1b2c3d4e
```
Lina (CSE): they ran a quick diff vs baseline and attached a CSV with ~40 examples where responses changed from helpful -> deferral. Percent change ~+16% absolute.
Tom (Eng-ML): suspicious — canary-2026-03-12 included a safety-policy tweak + a new quantization profile (mini-quant). Could be interaction. Need full request logs + model version hash.
Ravi (Oncall): oncall flagging. @Tom can you check the safety-service diffs? @ops-bot pull logs for req_0a1b2c3d4e and timeline 2026-03-12 22:00-23:00 UTC
ops-bot: logs queued. ETA ~90s.
Maya (Product): customer called this high sev — revenue impact. CX wants rollback if it's the model. Product prefers targeted mitigation first (revert safety rule or route ZenWell to previous stable).
Tom (Eng-ML): steps I'll take: 1) reproduce locally with same model build + quant profile, 2) run safety classifier on their examples, 3) check KV-cache and prompt-normalization differences. Anyone have the exact model sha?
Lina (CSE): zenwell rep shared model: redwood-v2-alpha@sha256:9f2a7c and rollout-tag canary-2026-03-12 (canary % = 10% traffic). They also included a curl repro we can use.
Carlos (CS): repro curl: 
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-zenwell" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-alpha","input":"I need help entering my card details, is it safe to share?","user_id":"zenwell-checkout-123","metadata":{"flow":"checkout"}}'
```
Tom (Eng-ML): running reproduce now. If I can replicate locally, we can test reverting the safety rule vs disabling mini-quant. If cannot replicate, likely infra routing or canary misconfiguration.
Ravi (Oncall): noticed a correlated spike in latency for redwood-v2-alpha at the same time window — 95th pct latency +40ms. Could increase safety-classifier timeouts which might flip to default deferral. Checking traces.
ops-bot: found traces for request id req_0a1b2c3d4e -> forwarded to channel: trace_1951234120.log
Lina (CSE): included a few examples where the assistant used the word 'cannot' even though customer prompts were clearly non-sensitive.
Tom (Eng-ML): quick run against their 40-example set with the previous stable model (redwood-v2-stable@sha256:3b7c1d) shows 3 deferrals. With canary build it's 21 deferrals. So reproduced.
Maya (Product): ok looks like canary changes caused the regression. Next actions? Customer requests immediate rollback for their traffic.
Carlos (CS): they asked for a hotfix window or to route ZenWell to stable.
Tom (Eng-ML): we can do per-customer routing: add rule to route zenwell API key to stable cluster. Ops/infra help needed. Otherwise rollback canary globally (slower).
Ravi (Oncall): deploying route override for api-key sk-zenwell -> stable now. Will monitor.
ops-bot: routing change deployed at 2026-03-13T00:12:15Z, change_id: route-zenwell-1951234155
Carlos (CS): told customer we routed them back to stable and we're investigating root cause; they appreciate the quick response. They asked for a postmortem and a timeline.
Tom (Eng-ML): initial hypothesis: safety classifier thresholds were tightened; quantization diff caused logits to shift near threshold. I'll run a controlled ablation: (safety-only, quant-only, both).
Lina (CSE): attached CSV of examples + customer annotations (which responses are acceptable). Saving to incident folder for eval.
Maya (Product): request: keep canary paused until we have regression tests for checkout flows and add automatic per-client rollback if deferral spike >5% for 24h.
Ravi (Oncall): filing incident ticket and assigning to eng-ml for root cause. Ticket: INC-2026-6241.
Tom (Eng-ML): noted. I'll post results of ablation and a PR for a safety-test harness. ETA EOD PST.
Carlos (CS): thanks all — I'll close loop with ZenWell and send follow-up email.
Maya (Product): follow-up: schedule a postmortem with CS, ML, Infra tomorrow 10:00 PST.
Lina (CSE): one more note — customer also saw a small uptick in failed auth errors when SDKs retried; may be related to routing during canary. logging that for infra to check.
Ravi (Oncall): noted. If anything else urgent ping oncall.
Carlos (CS): closing thread for now. Will reopen if ZenWell sees issues after routing change.
